caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cross with a human figure attached to it. The cross is colored in dark brown or black tones, and there are visible ropes tied around the intersection of its vertical and horizontal beams. The figure, which appears male, is shown wearing a light-colored cloth wrapped around the waist with horizontal dark stripes. The figure's arms are stretched out and affixed to the crossbeam, and the legs are slightly bent with one foot placed over the other, secured by a nail. The body is light tan with visible red streaks representing blood running down from wounds on the arms, legs, and torso. The head is inclined downward and tilted to one side and is adorned with a dark crown of thorns. The hair and beard are also dark. The background is plain, off-white with no additional objects or scenery. The bottom right corner contains a faint handwritten label: "MANEL G. CLIFLIN - TAOS."
title: Bulto, Crucifix
